payload.text/html:
Ridge hike packing list

  • Shelter

    • Tent body

      • Poles in three sections

      • Twelve stakes

    • Ground sheet
      folded in four

  • Water, two liters each

  1. Check the forecast

  2. File the route

    2. With a friend at home

  • Boots waxed

  • Map printed

    • North section

    • South section

  • A bullet list right after the task list

  1. An ordered list right after the bullet list

  • Kinds mixed under one item
